Tormull Mead
Brewer's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 1
1/2 Day Focused
3 Days Patient
A mossy smell wafts from the thick concoction, thankfully it tastes better than it smells.
Heady Durability 3 Uses - When you drink this mead, for 1 hour your 
Constitution score improves by 3, and your Dexterity score decreases by 1.

Rarity
Crafting Time
13
Kesh Nog [16.]
Brewer's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
2 Days Patient
Friendships can be made over a shared drink, and the warm Kesh Nog welcomes all.
Festive 4 Uses - When you drink Kesh Nog, for 1 hour you gain Advantage on 
Charisma (Persuasion) checks and if shared with another creature, they have 
Disadvantage against any Wisdom Saving Throws against you.
DC

1 Grakhnash’s Three Chambered Heart, 6 Burberry Beetle Eggs
Rarity
Crafting Time
14
Heartberry Brew
Brewer's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
2 Days Patient
The viscous drink of thick flesh chunks and egg juice tastes better than it looks at first glance.
When you drink this potion, for 1 day it grants an immediate 2d10 Temporary Hit 
Points above your maximum HP. In addition, it grants +2 to your Constitution 
and Advantage on all Constitution Saving Throws. While you feel fortified, 
there’s a noticeable feeling of lethargy and for the duration of the potion's effect, 
it imposes Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

1 Burberry Extracted Hemolymph, 1 Khanith Pheromone Gland, 1 Ricatrillisk Gut Fungus
Rarity
Crafting Time
15
Swarm Spice
Brewer's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
4 Days Patient
Drinking this spicy concoction is difficult, but it has a nice after taste once the burning stops.
When you drink this potion, your breath and pores exude a notably spicy aroma 
and nearby insects tend to listen to you a little more intently. For 1 hour, you gain 
Advantage on Charisma checks and gain +5 to your Animal Handling checks 
against insect (insecta) creatures.

1 Brookbud Leaves, 1 Chunk of Ferastack, 1 Lancelet Crushed Lancel Paste, 1 
Sacrissian Sclerotic Bone
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Fleeting Eye Pipe [15.]
Alchemist Supplies
Rare
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
In the haze of the narcotic, everyone moves so slowly around you, but unable to understand you.
Narcotic Paste The pipe can be refilled with 1 Lancelet Crushed Lancel Paste. 
Jittery Rush With a Utilize action you can Smoke this pipe. Once smoked, for 1 hour 
you gain Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks 
and Disadvantage to Charisma Saving Throws.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Dulleyed Cattail, 1 Khanaur Heavy Tarsal Claw, 1 Baughur Piercing Tusk
Rarity
Crafting Time
14
Stonerind Swig
Brewer's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
4 Days Patient
A strange lack of sensation and worry overwhelms the drinker, numbing them to pain and more.
When you drink this potion, for 1 hour you gain Resistance to Slashing and 
Piercing, but suffer Disadvantage to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks as your 
flesh numbs to subtle sensations.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Aphistus Toothed Tongue, 1 Krainis Venom Extract
Rarity
Crafting Time
13
Liar's Tongue Tonic [14.]
Brewer's Supplies
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1/4 Day Focused
1 Day Patient
A tingling sensation loosens the tongue and the drinker cannot seem to hide the truth.
Truth’s Tonic When consumed, it grants immunity to Poison damage and the 
Poisoned condition from any poisonous sources for 1 hour. It also acts an immediate 
cure for those already suffering from the Poisoned condition. For the duration of 
the potion's effect, it imposes Disadvantage on Deception Saving Throws.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Bloomux Honeywomb Nectar, 1 Vial of Vigael 
Rarity
Crafting Time
12
Blooming Brew
Brewer's Supplies
Common
Supplies: 2
1/2 Day Focused
4 Days Patient
The bloomux drink deep from many flowers throughout the Farplains to create a healthy honey.
When you drink this potion, it grants you a number of beneficial, but unpredictable 
results. Roll a 1d4 and immediately receive the following effects:
1 A sense of serene calm envelops the Traveler and they immediately receive the 
 benefit of a short rest and can spend Hit Dice to regain Hit Points.
2 The Traveler’s natural ability to heal is hastened dramatically and they heal 2d6 
 Hit Points. Additionally, any Hit Points beyond what would normally be restored 
 add temporary Hit Points. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 hour. 
3 A feeling of nimble energy overwhelms the Traveler, granting 1 hour of 
 Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. 
4 The Traveler’s skin toughens and muscles tighten with strength, granting 1 hour 
'  of Advantage on Strength Saving Throws. A Traveler may only gain the effects of
  1 Blooming Brew per Long Rest.
DC
Tool Proficiency
3 Amber Shards, 1 Rutort Shovel Tusk, 3 Hectatrex Gastroliths, 4 Omaterssum Curved Canines
Rarity
Crafting Time
17
Grayfynn Staff
Woodcarver's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 3
2 Days Focused
The soothing sounds of the wind and rain's tranquility can be heard in the long hollow bone.
Grayfynn Sanctuary Once per day, with a Utilization Action you can plant 
the staff into the ground, emitting a serene rain-like sound in a 30 ft. radius 
centered on the staff. Inside this sanctuary, all creatures, including the wielder, 
regain Hit Points equal to their Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turn. 
Additionally, creatures inside the space have Advantage on Saving Throws 
against being Charmed or Frightened. The sanctuary lasts for 10 minutes or 
until the staff is removed from the ground.
DC
Tool Proficiency
2 Moonspun Silk Threads, 1 Strands Stalk, 1 Sacrissian Tooth Lined Beak
Rarity
Crafting Time
18
Lyre's Maw [11.]
Tinker's Tools
Very Rare
Supplies: 4
3 Days Focused
The lethally sharp beak can do more the eviscerate prey, it can sing to them.
Toothy Twang The lyre has two distinct tunes that can be played, to activate 
these effects, you must select which tune to play before using a Utilization 
action to play the instrument.
Predator’s Melody Creatures within 30 ft. that can hear, gain Advantage on their 
next Wisdom Saving Throw for 1 hour. 
Prey’s Lament Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each other creature in a 30 ft. 
Emanation originating from the lyre player. Failure: Affected creatures 
must disengage and flee 10 ft. immediately away from the player and have 
Disadvantage on their next attack roll.
CONSUMABLES
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Ironwood Log, 1 Dross Grass Thread, 2 Fennfistle Spined Gulars
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Croak Stool Drum [13.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 4
2 Days Focused
There's a madness to the Fenlands, a chaos that speaks to the primal beat of nature.
Chaotic Croak Beats With a Utilization Action you may play the drums. Wisdom 
Saving Throw: DC 15, each other creature in a 60 ft. Emanation originating from 
the drum player. Failure: Target creature suffers madness, exhibiting erratic 
behavior as they attempt to dance to the chaotic beat, and cannot perform any 
Actions besides dancing. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of 
its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After the drumming stops it 
succeeds automatically and cannot be affected by the drums for 1 day.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Stonecrest Sparrow Ocarina Crest
Rarity
Crafting Time
14
Shatterstone Ocarina [12.]
Tinker's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
Capable of beautiful music, and beautiful destruction, if the right note is played.
Shatterstone Tone With a Utilization Action you can play a specific tune by 
making a DC 12 Performance check. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each other 
creature in a 30 ft. Emanation from the ocarina player. Failure: 2d8 Thunder 
damage. Success: Half damage. The Saving Throw DC is increased by 2 if you have 
proficiency with Ocarina instruments.
Stonecrest Melodies The ocarina can be used to play music. However, if you roll 
a Critical Fail on a Performance check while playing the ocarina, including the 
Shatterstone Tone, it shatters, broken and irreparable.
INSTRUMENTS
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Moonspun Silk Thread, 1 Crested Quill Quilled Abdomen, 1 Khanith Rigid Wing
Rarity
Crafting Time
15
Trilling Quill
Woodcarver's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
The buzz of the harmonica speaks to an ancient song, one of heat and hunger.
Summoning Song If you are within the Wealdwoods or an equivalently forested 
area, you can take a Utilize Action to blow softly into the harmonica. Doing so 
summons a single Crested Quill that has no statblock. It flutters about or hides 
in your clothing for 1 day. The insect can remain with you as long as you use the 
Summoning Song once per day.
Screeching Strain If the wielder has the single Crested Quill summoned, they 
can blow into the harmonica with a Utilize Action. The Crested Quill immediately 
darts out and attacks a random creature, friend or foe within 30 ft. of the wielder. 
Roll a 1d20 per Creature, not counting the wielder, the highest roll receives the 
attack. Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 30 ft. Hit: 76 (2d6) Piercing damage

Tool Proficiency
Rarity
Crafting Time

1 Arkiopti Stalked Eye, 1 Taurachni Ocellus, 1 Maedrynn Glucose Rich Blood
Primordial Soup
Alchemist's Supplies
Legendary
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
1 Day Patient
The thick liquid exudes a strong savory smell, welcoming all to the stirring pot of scarlet 
soup. Any who partake find themselves feeling invigorated like never before.
Serves 6, when you drink from a bowl of Primordial Soup, roll 1d4 and gain the 
following result for 1 day. Drinking again will have no effect until the first effect 
wears off.
1- Toughed Flesh Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing 
damage, if you already have Resistance to any of these, gain +1 AC against any of 
those attack types.
2- Blood Surge Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level + Constitution 
modifier + Proficiency.
3- Legendary Stamina You gain a count of 3 Legendary Resistance (if you fail a 
Saving Throw, you may choose to succeed instead).
4- Second Breath If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you instead drop to 1 Hit 
Point and immediately regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution Modifier.
